description: A region's apex cutoffs right now: the LP needed for Challenger and for Grandmaster (`challengerCutoff`, `grandmasterCutoff`), how many players hold each apex tier, how much each cutoff moved since the region's midnight (`*DeltaToday`, null when unknown), when the ladder snapshot ran (`updatedAtMs`), and the primary-role mix of the top 200. Cutoffs are positional (Riot's apex slots), not a formula.
name: get_rank_cutoffs
title: Challenger / Grandmaster LP cutoffs
